# Help translate MineOffice

MineOffice ships in **English** and **Thai**. We would love more languages, and you do not need to know how to code: the text lives in one JSON file.

**How to help:** comment here with the language you want to take on, so two people do not do the same one, then follow [Translating in CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#translating).

A partial translation is welcome. Anything left out shows in English until someone fills it in.

## Languages

- [x] English (`en`)
- [x] Thai (`th`)
- [ ] Chinese, Simplified (`zh`)
- [ ] Japanese (`ja`)
- [ ] Korean (`ko`)
- [ ] Spanish (`es`)
- [ ] Portuguese (`pt`)
- [ ] French (`fr`)
- [ ] German (`de`)
- [ ] Russian (`ru`)
- [ ] Indonesian (`id`)
- [ ] Vietnamese (`vi`)

Your language is not listed? Comment and we will add it.
